scope: City and County of San Francisco only; free events preferred (gaming, music, AI, then everything else), paid events collected in a separate section
policy: Only pages of the organiser, the agency or the venue itself were treated as sources. Every candidate records the exact page that was fetched. A field that the fetched page does not state is left blank; nothing is inferred. A candidate is only marked 'added' when every value in the row comes from the fetched official page.
